goddessOfTheHarvest.name: Goddess of the Harvest
goddessOfTheHarvest.flavor: She counts the sheaves before the reapers do.
goddessOfTheHarvest.text: +1 food on every hex carrying a bonus resource that pays food.

keeperOfTheHearth.name: Keeper of the Hearth
keeperOfTheHearth.flavor: A fire that has never gone out is worth more than a wall.
keeperOfTheHearth.text: Granaries supply +1 faith. +1 happiness in the capital.

starReaders.name: Star Readers
starReaders.flavor: From the high rock the year is a wheel you can see the spokes of.
starReaders.text: +3 science in every city beside a mountain.

keeperOfTheCalendar.name: Keeper of the Calendar
keeperOfTheCalendar.flavor: Nothing is lost that was written down on the right day.
keeperOfTheCalendar.text: Every 20 turns, you are offered a find from a ruin. A ruin pays once for each age you have reached.

theStandingStones.name: The Standing Stones
theStandingStones.flavor: They were raised by people who expected to be remembered, and were.

ancestorWorship.name: Ancestor Worship
ancestorWorship.flavor: The dead outnumber us, and they vote.
ancestorWorship.text: +1 culture in every city of 4 or more population. +5% culture in every city of 10 or more.

ladyOfTheHunt.name: Lady of the Hunt
ladyOfTheHunt.flavor: She takes the first kill and leaves the rest, which is why there is a rest.
ladyOfTheHunt.text: +1 food and +1 gold on every hex with a Camp improvement. Clearing a barbarian camp pays +10 faith.

spiritsOfTheWood.name: Spirits of the Wood
spiritsOfTheWood.flavor: Ask before the axe; the asking is the whole of the rite.
spiritsOfTheWood.text: Clearing a forest or jungle pays +15 faith. +1 culture on every forest hex.

riverMother.name: River Mother
riverMother.flavor: She is not kind. She is regular, which is better.
riverMother.text: +2 food in every city on fresh water. Those cities' shrines supply +1 happiness.

lordOfTheSea.name: Lord of the Sea
lordOfTheSea.flavor: He keeps the count of every net, and forgives none of it.
lordOfTheSea.text: +1 production and +1 gold on every hex with a Fishing Boat.

godOfTheForge.name: God of the Forge
godOfTheForge.flavor: He was lamed by his own work and never once stopped.
godOfTheForge.text: Barracks supply +1 production. All your units gain +1 combat strength.

ritesOfBlood.name: Rites of Blood
ritesOfBlood.flavor: The altar is old. The queue in front of it is older.
ritesOfBlood.text: Killing a unit pays +15 faith, once for each age you have reached.

oracleOfTheCrossroads.name: Oracle of the Crossroads
oracleOfTheCrossroads.flavor: Every road is a question. She charges for the answer.
oracleOfTheCrossroads.text: +3 faith for each ruin you claim. Scouts see one hex further.

sacredFire.name: Sacred Fire
sacredFire.flavor: No story, no festival, no priest. It simply must not go out.

desertFathers.name: Desert Fathers
desertFathers.flavor: They went out to find nothing, and were the first to succeed.

winterMother.name: Winter Mother
winterMother.flavor: She does not sleep through it. She is it.
winterMother.text: +1 food on every tundra hex. +1 faith on every tundra hex that is wooded.

lordOfTheHoard.name: Lord of the Hoard
lordOfTheHoard.flavor: He counts it nightly. He has never spent any of it.
lordOfTheHoard.text: +1 culture and +1 faith on every hex with a Mine carrying a luxury resource.

courtAugurs.name: Court Augurs
courtAugurs.flavor: Keep one at home. The omens travel badly.
courtAugurs.text: +5% science and +5% culture for each augur stationed in a city with a rite left.

riteOfTheHarvest.name: Rite of the Harvest
riteOfTheHarvest.flavor: The grain was always going to come up. Somebody has to be thanked.

omenReading.name: Omen Reading
omenReading.flavor: The liver said what the scribe already suspected.

consecrationOfTheBounds.name: Consecration of the Bounds
consecrationOfTheBounds.flavor: Walk the line once a year and the line walks itself the rest of it.

blessingOfArms.name: Blessing of Arms
blessingOfArms.flavor: The god does not promise you live. Only that it will be worth watching.

riteOfPlenty.name: Rite of Plenty
riteOfPlenty.flavor: A feast is an argument that the year was good, made loudly enough to win.
